classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof
composition_rules: Preserve exact scoped identity; do not unify by name.
Resolve explicit uses_definition edges to transitive closure with exact version bindings.
Analyze legitimate mutual meanings jointly in SCCs under their specified semantics.
Unresolved external dependencies block whole-definition readiness.
Separate family editorial grouping from semantic dependency closure.
One combined model must interpret all included shared symbols; separately satisfiable projections do not suffice.

invariant_contexts.allowed_state_consistency: Include the invariant constraint and ask whether allowed states/model populations coexist.
invariant_contexts.implementation_preservation: Do not assume the preservation target; independently define initial states and transitions, then prove base and inductive step/reachable-state property.

recursion: Ordinary recursive equivalence is not a least fixed point; select induction/fixed-point/well-founded semantics before a recursive closure is accepted.

independent-axis.populations: selected relevant hypothetical inhabitants; not all Cartesian combinations by default
independent-axis.target: countermodel for each named forbidden implication; frame constraints and permitted couplings retained

overlap-distinct.populations: both concepts inhabited; direction and all-model strength explicit
overlap-distinct.target: intersection witness plus selected directed difference witnesses

subtype.populations: inhabit child when required; parent difference only for selected properness

unresolved.target: no semantic acceptance until actual alignment/classification complete

theory_components: explicitly selected assumptions in named contexts
explicit couplings and invariants for the chosen query
